scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(process.env.CF_PAGES){try{require('child_process').execSync('rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules bun.lock bun.lockb',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.error('preinstall cleanup skipped:',e.message)}}"
scripts.build: node -e "if(process.env.CF_PAGES){require('child_process').execSync('pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project packages/shared/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @mp-calculator/web run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{require('child_process').execSync('turbo run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @mp-calculator/shared run build && pnpm --filter @mp-calculator/web run build
